note: Triennial rural district council election. Polling in Co. Down took place on Thursday 25 May 1933 and the results were announced on Friday 26 May. The Moira division was the only contest in this district. Filed on 1933-05-25, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). The other divisions are from the Belfast Telegraph nominations list of 27 April 1933 (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Marlin (Maralin) had no nomination: its member, Joseph E. Lonsdale, had died, so there was no retiring member; at the annual meeting the co-option of a member in place of the late Mr. Lonsdale was deferred (Banbridge Chronicle, 3 June 1933, p. 8). The seat fell to the council to fill as a casual vacancy; it is not an election. Returned unopposed.
